newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Counsel as strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Counsel as strong buy.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said analyst Ed Kroll initiated Counsel Corp with a strong buy rating.
-- Counsel is a Toronto-based investment company, with holdings focused in U.S. healthcare services firms, American HomePatient Inc and Capstone Pharmacy Services Inc .
-- said two key executives, Alan Silber and Morris Perlis, "are building high credibility with investors" through roles as chairmen of Capstone Pharmacy and American HomePatient, respectively.
-- believes stock is "vastly undervalued," and has $15 price target. Shares rose 3/8 to 10-7/8 in midmorning exchange trading.
